name: swiftui-previews
description: SwiftUI previews with hot reload for Bazel (rules_swift / rules_apple) projects, in a pane beside the chat.

swiftpreviewPath.title: swiftpreview binary
swiftpreviewPath.description: Path to the swiftpreview CLI (tools/swiftpreview in the swift-agent-tools repo, built with `swift build -c release`). Default: swiftpreview on PATH.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Where clicking the file name in the pane opens the preview's source: xcode (xed), vscode (code), cursor, or default (the app macOS opens .swift files with).

discoverPreviews.title: Find workspace previews automatically
discoverPreviews.description: List every preview in the Bazel workspace for the pane's pickers each time a preview starts (Bazel queries, no build). Off: the pickers list the open file's previews, and the pane's "Find previews in the workspace" button or /preview list runs the search.

keepHostMinutes.title: Keep the iOS host running (minutes)
keepHostMinutes.description: After a preview stops, leave its host app running in the simulator this long, so starting again in the same tab skips installing and launching it. 0 stops it at once.

simulatorIdleMinutes.title: Shut down idle simulators (minutes)
simulatorIdleMinutes.description: Shut down a simulator swiftpreview booted once no preview has used it this long. Simulators you booted yourself are never shut down. 0 leaves them booted.

watch.title: Watching for saves
watch.description: poll: check each source file's modification time every poll interval. events: macOS file events (FSEvents). auto: poll up to the file limit below, else events.

pollIntervalMs.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollIntervalMs.description: How often polling checks the sources for saves.

watchEventsAbove.title: Use file events above (files)
watchEventsAbove.description: With watching on auto: poll up to this many source files, use file events above it.
